sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: The amount of water in a tank is given by G = 13t + 3, where G is the number of gallons in the tank and t is the number of minutes since filling started. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The tank already had 13 gallons of water before filling started.
The tank fills at a rate of 3 gallons per minute.
The tank already had 3 gallons of water before filling started.
The tank fills at a rate of 13 gallons per minute.

items.prompt: A moving company's total cost is given by C = 1h + 17, where C is the total cost in dollars and h is the number of hours of labor. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The company charges a flat fee of $1 before any labor hours.
The company charges $1 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges $17 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges a flat fee of $17 before any labor hours.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (8, 10) and (11, 8).

A line passes through these points:
x: 1, 8, 15, 22
y: 18, 7, -4, -15
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?

A line passes through (-7, -15). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 8 and a vertical leg (rise) of 9. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 2 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?
A line has a slope of -1/2. A right triangle drawn along the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 25 units. What is the length of the other leg?
Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of the line through (3, -3) and (6, -1).
Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line -11x + y = -10. Rearrange into slope-intercept form first.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt:
Relationship A: y = (7/5)x
Relationship B (proportional):
x: 3, 6, 9
y: 5, 10, 15
By how much does the greater rate of change exceed the lesser rate of change?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: For the line y = (11/4)x + 19, find y when x = 0.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
